offset.label: Timing offset (ms)
offset.description: Positive values show lines earlier, negative ones later.

players.label: Only these players
players.description: Follow only players whose name contains one of these, e.g. spotify. Leave empty to follow all.

ignored_players.label: Ignored players
ignored_players.description: Never follow players whose name contains one of these, e.g. firefox.

mode.label: Show
mode.lyrics: Lyrics, track when there are none

max_length.label: Max length
max_length.description: Longer text gets cut off, in characters. 0 means no limit.

scroll.label: Scroll long text
scroll.description: Instead of cutting it off at the max length. Lyric lines scroll once, timed to the line; the track loops.
